newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds Ship.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds Ship.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
SOUTH KOREA, Jan 30 - Busan - 178 Vessels in port. 73 At berth, 105 at anchorage. Usually 3-4 days delay due to berth congestion.
Pohang - 23 Vessels in port. 15 At berth, 8 at anchorage. No delay.
Inchon - 80 Vessels in port. 55 At berth, 25 at anchorage. Usually 1-2 days delay due to berth congestion.
